changelog: - **Every project-owned write is now behind the `projects` capability** (#2356, epic #2349 — adversarial-review follow-up to #2473). #2473 gated the six obvious project routes but the review found six more paths that create or change project-owned rows without a gate: `PATCH`/`DELETE /api/project-tasks/[taskId]` (project-bound tasks only — personal to-dos stay open), the PROJECT_TASK branch of note→task conversion (`/api/notes/[id]/convert`, whose own comment promised a gate that was never added), `POST /api/invite` with a `projectId` (acceptance upserts a `ProjectMember`), a project-bound contributor-terms acceptance, `POST /api/conversations` with a `projectId` (the project's group conversation), and the project meeting writers (`/api/meeting-series` POST/PUT/DELETE, `/api/meetings/instant` with a `projectId`). All now call `requireCapability(orgId, 'projects')` and answer `403 capability_unavailable` for a tenant without the module; the gates that depend on a `projectId` in the body are conditional so the non-project use of the same route is untouched. `e2e/vertical-write-gate.spec.ts`'s GATED table gains the six project routes whose gate an empty POST reaches, so a regression is visible to CI. INTERNSHIP carries every capability — no behaviour change there.
